description.value: At 6th level, whenever the warrior takes lethal damage, 1 point of this damage may be converted to nonlethal damage, warrior's choice. The amount of damage that may be converted increases to 2 points of damage at 10th level, 3 points of damage at 14th level, and 4 points of damage at 18th level. This damage conversion has no effect on bleed damage or damage that is already nonlethal.
